seed app.example.com
seed geo.example.com

origin example.com ip 192.0.2.10 via - provider - servers web01 exposure -

origin api.example.com ip 192.0.2.13 via - provider - servers - exposure -
origin app.example.com host origin-lb.example.net via - provider - servers - exposure -
origin www.example.com ip 192.0.2.10,2001:db8::10 via - provider - servers web01 exposure -
address 10.20.30.40 intranet.example.com servers - private
address 192.0.2.10 example.com* *.example.com*~ www.example.com* servers web01
address 192.0.2.12 admin.example.com servers -
address 192.0.2.13 api.example.com* servers -

address 198.51.100.30 geo.example.com servers -
address 2001:db8::10 *.example.com*~ www.example.com* servers -
handoff target 192.0.2.10
handoff target 192.0.2.13
handoff target 2001:db8::10
handoff host origin-lb.example.net
handoff name example.com
handoff name *.example.com
handoff name api.example.com
handoff name app.example.com
handoff name www.example.com
